---
title: "Browse all notices"
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
notices = {
  try {
    return await FileAttachment("notices.json").json();
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

icOptions = {
  const set = new Set();
  for (const n of notices) for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) set.add(ic);
  return ["(any)", ...Array.from(set).sort()];
}

typeOptions = ["(any)", ...Array.from(new Set(notices.map(n => n.notice_type).filter(Boolean))).sort()];
topicOptions = {
  const set = new Set();
  for (const n of notices) for (const t of (n.topics || [])) set.add(t);
  return ["(any)", ...Array.from(set).sort()];
}
mechOptions = {
  const set = new Set();
  for (const n of notices) for (const m of (n.mechanisms || [])) set.add(m);
  return ["(any)", ...Array.from(set).sort()];
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof ic   = Inputs.select(icOptions,    {label: "Institute"})
viewof type = Inputs.select(typeOptions,  {label: "Type"})
viewof mech = Inputs.select(mechOptions,  {label: "Mechanism"})
viewof topic = Inputs.select(topicOptions, {label: "Topic"})
viewof q    = Inputs.search(notices, {placeholder: "Search title and TL;DR…"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
filtered = q.filter(n =>
  (ic    === "(any)" || (n.issuing_orgs || []).includes(ic)) &&
  (type  === "(any)" || n.notice_type === type) &&
  (mech  === "(any)" || (n.mechanisms || []).includes(mech)) &&
  (topic === "(any)" || (n.topics || []).includes(topic))
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p><strong>${filtered.length}</strong> of ${notices.length} notices.</p>`

Inputs.table(filtered, {
  columns: ["release_date", "notice_id", "notice_type", "title", "issuing_orgs", "mechanisms", "topics"],
  format: {
    notice_id:    id => html`<a href="${(filtered.find(n => n.notice_id === id) || {}).url}" target="_blank">${id}</a>`,
    issuing_orgs: xs => (xs || []).join(", "),
    mechanisms:   xs => (xs || []).join(", "),
    topics:       xs => (xs || []).join(", "),
  },
  rows: 20
})
```
